Monster: Basarios | CR: 6 | Tier: 2

Weapon Effect

Your bludgeoning weapon deals an extra [[/r 1d4]] bludgeoning damage.

Armor Effect

Guts. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this property, you can't use it again for 2 days.
